Privacy Policy

At AlternaVest Meridian, your trust is our sovereign priority. This protocol outlines how we safeguard the integrity and confidentiality of your institutional and personal data assets.

Effective Date October 24, 2023
Last Updated April 12, 2024

01. Data Collection Protocol

We collect information necessary to provide institutional-grade financial services and to comply with global regulatory standards (KYC/AML). This includes:

  • circle Entity Verification: Full legal names, corporate structures, and tax identification details.
  • circle Transactional Metadata: Ledger entries, asset allocations, and historical performance tracking.
  • circle Technical Fingerprints: Device identifiers and encrypted session logs to prevent unauthorized access.

02. Utilization & Stewardship

Data is processed exclusively through our Sovereign Ledger infrastructure. We do not engage in data monetization or cross-platform marketing with third parties.

Information is utilized to optimize your portfolio insights, automate regulatory reporting, and provide the high-touch advisory services characteristic of the Meridian experience.

"The sanctity of the ledger is absolute. We employ post-quantum encryption standards for all archival data."

03. Global Compliance

GDPR / EEA

Full rights to erasure, portability, and access are guaranteed for European economic zone partners.

CCPA / CPRA

California residents maintain specific controls over the 'sale' and sharing of sensitive financial metadata.

04. Contact & Inquiry

For inquiries regarding our data governance frameworks or to exercise your rights under global privacy laws, please contact our Data Protection Officer.
